name: Dormitory
summary: In Gnomeregan, troggs now overrun the Dormitory, and radiation chokes its halls. Gnomes once made their homes here, but the creatures that drove them out now hold the fallen city's residential quarters.

sections.title: A Home Overrun
sections.body: Beyond the Clean Zone's decontamination chambers, the Dormitory once housed Gnomeregan's inventors, laborers, and families. When High Tinker Mekkatorque opened the emergency radiation vents to fight the invading troggs, this crowded part of the city became a trap. No gnomish life remains in its communal halls or living quarters. Mutated troggs thrive in the radioactive air. To reach the lower Hall of Gears, travelers must fight through this reminder of the catastrophe.

sections.title: Punchograph Terminals
sections.body: Though the living quarters are abandoned, Gnomeregan's administrative machines still work. Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals process security punch cards. The cards open higher-security data terminals deeper in the city, where important records remain from the gnomes' flight.

faq.q: What was the Dormitory used for before the fall?
faq.answer: The Dormitory housed Gnomeregan's inventors, workers, and families. Near the industrial and civic sectors, residents could reach their workstations and sleeping bunks before toxic radiation flooded the lower corridors.

faq.q: Why is the Dormitory infested with troggs?
faq.answer: When troggs broke into the city from below, High Tinker Mekkatorque flooded it with toxic gas to kill them. Radiation instead mutated the survivors, leaving them more vicious and wholly resistant to the irradiated residential blocks.
The Dormitory lies beyond the Clean Zone's sanitized airlocks and connects the upper levels to the lower Hall of Gears. Anyone going deeper into Gnomeregan must pass through it.

faq.q: What are the Matrix Punchograph machines found here?
faq.answer: Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals process security punch cards. The encoded cards open higher-security terminals and help recover important data left behind in Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a gnome, the Dormitory was once home. Now irradiated rubble fills its halls, overrun by the brutes who drove your people out.
Even amid a failure of bio-containment, automated Matrix Punchograph 3005-B terminals still process algorithmic security punch cards without fail.
